# Nolan River Dental Center

> > Comprehensive family and cosmetic dental practice in Cleburne, Texas led by Dr. Amy Case and Dr. Brian Case, offering preventive, restorative, implant, and emergency dental services.

Nolan River Dental Center is a full-service dental practice serving the Cleburne, Texas community with a focus on quality care at accessible prices. The practice specializes in family dentistry, cosmetic procedures, dental implants, and emergency care, supported by an experienced team of dental professionals.
